description: This file defines a utility class 'StartupCommandUtil' for processing command line arguments for the OFBiz framework. It handles parsing, validation, and help display of startup options like start, shutdown, load data, and tests, using the Apache Commons CLI library.

classes.name: StartupCommandUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse and validate command line arguments for OFBiz startup commands, and to display help information.

methods.name: parseOfbizCommands
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into a list of StartupCommand objects, throwing an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: printOfbizStartupHelp
methods.description: Prints a detailed help message explaining usage of OFBiz startup commands.

methods.name: highlightAndPrintErrorMessage
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error with visual separators.
